#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * AUTO-CONTINUE: Hard-coded error correction for agent responses
 * Detects incomplete agent outputs and automatically generates "continue" prompts
 * 
 * This script monitors agent communications and automatically triggers
 * "continue" prompts when responses are:
 * - Incomplete (suggestions only, no action)
 * - Passive ("could", "would", "should" language)
 * - Meta-commentary ("To do this, you would...")
 * - Questioning instead of executing
 * - Active for >30 minu
